build.qualification: Forty-eight fixed case/level pairs across seven inputs and three immutable dictionary kinds cover the six admitted combined-staging profiles. Clock-free ledgers separate the dictionary allocation domain (unchanged snapshots through every call) from the per-call scratch domain (complete release) for stateless and persistent coordinator configurations; both configurations produce the same frame bytes. Every backend build must reproduce the same 576-row ledger. No measured performance claim before complete qualified builds and the full matrix.

primary_timing.qualification: Per-attempt compression clocks include every codec scratch allocation and release through Global. Stateless and persistent coordinator calls resolve the same request against the same source and dictionary, borrow the same immutable view, write the same caller destination prepared outside clocks and produce identical bytes; dictionary construction, destination setup, full-byte/guard/ledger validation remain outside clocks. The coordinator construction setup batch includes loop and black-box overhead and is not a directly subtractable per-attempt estimate. Equal timer overhead is retained; no universal profile benefit or absence of scratch allocation is claimed.

summary.unit: nanoseconds per operation for compression modes; nanoseconds per 4096-pair batch for setup observations
summary.aggregation: Equal-weight geometric mean of per-pair median latency ratios over 141 nonempty case/level pairs; the three empty-input pairs remain separate. Both configurations include per-call Global codec scratch, write a caller destination prepared outside clocks, resolve the same request against the same source and borrowed dictionary view and produce identical bytes. Coordinator ratios isolate the persistent selection claim and dictionary-view borrow machinery. Setup-only observations time whole 4096-operation construction/observation/drop batches that include loop and black-box overhead and are not a directly subtractable estimate of per-attempt overhead. No confidence intervals, universal profile benefit or desktop idleness claim.

qualification: All 24 safe/isolated/all production feature selections and two independently rebuilt safe/all repeats retain 1455 timing samples and 576 qualification rows per executable: stateless and persistent coordinator configurations over 48 case/level pairs and three immutable dictionary kinds, plus setup-only coordinator construction/observation/drop batch observations whose loop and black-box overhead is included and not directly subtractable. Dictionary and scratch ledgers are outside timings; Global per-call scratch is inside. Both configurations resolve the same request, borrow the same immutable view, write the same caller destination, produce identical bytes and record identical ledgers. Actual process barriers precede campaigns. No universal profile benefit, absence of scratch allocation, C byte identity or complete codec replacement is claimed.
